tha-ap338:1.1: Pabhaṅkara.] Padumuttarassa bhagavato lokajeṭṭhassa tādino / pavane cetiyam āsi vāḷamigasamākule. // //
tha-ap338:2.1: Na koci visahī gantuṃ cetiyam abhivandituṃ / tiṇakaṭṭhalatonaddhaṃ paluggam āsi cetiyaṃ. // //
tha-ap338:3.1: Vanakammiko tadā āsiṃ pitupetāmahen' ahaṃ / addasaṃ pavane thūpaṃ luggaṃ tiṇalatākulaṃ. // //
tha-ap338:4.1: Disvān' ahaṃ Buddhathūpaṃ garucittam upaṭṭhahiṃ / Buddhaseṭṭhassa thūpo yaṃ paluggo acchatī vane. // //
tha-ap338:5.1: Nacchannaṃ nappatirūpaṃ jānantassa guṇāguṇaṃ / Buddhathūpam asodhetvā aññakammaṃ payojaye. // //
tha-ap338:6.1: Tiṇakaṭṭhañ ca vallin ca *sodhayitvāna cetiye / vanditvā* aṭṭha *vā*rāni paṭikuṭiko agacch' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap338:7.1: Tena kammena sukatena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca / jahitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ Tāvatiṃsam agacch' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap338:8.1: Tattha me sukataṃ vyamhaṃ sovaṇṇaṃ sappabhassaraṃ / saṭṭhiyojanam ubbedhaṃ tiṃsayojanavitthataṃ. // //
tha-ap338:9.1: Tisatāni ca vārāni devarajjam akārayiṃ / pañcavīsatikkhattuñ ca cakkavattī ahos' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap338:10.1: Bhavābhave saṃsaranto mahābhogaṃ labhām' ahaṃ / bhoge me ūṇatā n' atthi sodhanāya idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap338:11.1: Siviyā hatthikkhandhena pavane gacchato mamaṃ / yaṃ yaṃ disāhaṃ gacchāmi saraṇaṃ sampajjate dhanaṃ. // //
tha-ap338:12.1: Khāṇuṃ vā kaṇṭakaṃ vāpi nāhaṃ passāmi cakkhunā / puññakammena saṃyutto sayam evāpaṇiyyare. // //
tha-ap338:13.1: Kuṭṭhaṃ gaṇḍo kilāso ca apamāro vitacchikā / daddu kaṇḍu ca me n' atthi sodhanāya idhaṃ phalaṃ // //
tha-ap338:14.1: Aññaṃ pi me acchariyaṃ Buddhathūpassa sodhane / nābhijānāmi me kāye jātaṃ pilakabindukaṃ. // //
tha-ap338:15.1: Aññaṃ pi me acchariyaṃ Buddhathūpamhi sodhite / duve bhave saṃsarāmi devatte atha mānuse. // //
tha-ap338:16.1: Aññaṃ pi me acchariyaṃ Buddhathūpamhi sodhite / suvaṇṇavaṇṇo sabbattha sappabhāso bhavām' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap338:17.1: Aññam pi me acchariyaṃ Buddhathūpamhi sodhite / amanāpaṃ vivajjeti manāpam upatiṭṭhati. // //
tha-ap338:18.1: Aññaṃ pi me acchariyaṃ Buddhathūpamhi sodhite / visuddhaṃ hoti me cittam ekaggaṃ susamāhitaṃ. // //
tha-ap338:19.1: Aññaṃ pi me acchariyaṃ Buddhathūpamhi sodhite / ekāsane nisīditvā arahattam apāpuṇiṃ. // //
tha-ap338:20.1: Satasahasse ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi sodhanāya idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap338:22.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Pabhaṅkaro thero i. g. a-ti.
